subject: Re: Collection Attempt Posted Against Different Token Total — TXID Alignment
body:
--- Message 1 (oldest) ---
From: Lena Park <lena.park@novum.ai>
To: billing@redwood.ai
Cc: finance@novumpayments.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Discrepancy: Collection Posted, Token total mismatch (TXID attached)

Hi Redwood billing team,

We noticed that a collection attempt posted on Apr 12 shows up in our bank feed (TXID 7c9b2) but the token total on the settled invoice (attached) is 1,048,560 while our account console shows 1,024,280 tokens billed for the same period. The net amount collected doesn't match the invoice line items.

Attached: invoice_NOVUM_202704.pdf (PDF, 142KB), txid_20270412-0415.csv (CSV, 12KB)

Can you confirm:
- Which token-count source was used to generate the posted collection?
- If any retroactive adjustment or reaggregation ran after the invoice was issued?
- Whether you can provide a per-request export for Apr 12–15 to reconcile?

We're trying to clear this with our payments team; the mismatch is causing a hold on our account. Please let us know asap — we can escalate to procurement if needed.

Thanks,
Lena Park
Head of Finance — Novum AI
Lena.Park@novum.ai

--- Message 2 ---
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@novum.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discrepancy: Collection Posted, Token total mismatch (TXID attached)

Hi Lena — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the invoice and TXID. I'm looping in Monica from Billing Ops and Jonas from Platform so we can get logs and a quick root-cause check.

Short answer: we will provide a per-request export for Apr 12–15 and double-check whether an after-the-fact aggregation job altered the invoice after the collection. We may need a provisional credit while we investigate — are you authorized to accept a provisional credit pending final reconciliation?

Action items I'm assigning:
- Monica: fetch per-request logs and the aggregation job run history for Apr 12–15; check if any reprocessing job completed after invoice generation.
- Jonas: confirm whether any cross-region replication or retry could have caused duplicated ingestion for Novum's tenant id (tenant: novum-prod-9882).

We'll aim to send an initial investigator report within 6 business hours.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Customer Finance 
Redwood Inference
Evelyn.Hart@redwood.ai

--- Message 3 ---
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Lena Park <lena.park@novum.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 13:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discrepancy: Collection Posted, Token total mismatch (TXID attached)

Hi all — quick investigation summary below (initial triage). I pulled the per-request export and aggregation history for tenant novum-prod-9882.

Findings (preliminary):
- Invoice generation time: 2027-04-12T04:15:20Z — at that time our billing pipeline snapshot reported 1,024,280 total tokens (matches what you see in the console).
- Post-invoice reprocessing: There was a backfill job that re-ingested a retry queue between 2027-04-12T06:30:00Z and 2027-04-12T07:10:00Z to recover dropped websocket events for region us-west-2.
- The retry job created duplicate requests for ~24,280 tokens (these were not deduplicated by the initial dedupe pass because request ids were missing on some retransmissions). The job ran after invoice generation but before the collection settlement timestamp.
- The collection posted by our payment processor used the final settled amount (invoice + post-invoice adjustments) and is therefore higher than the original invoice snapshot. The TXID attached by Novum (7c9b2) corresponds to the settled ledger item at 2027-04-12T07:25:12Z.

Attachments included in this message: per_request_export_20270412-15.csv (CSV, 2.1MB) — contains request_id, timestamp, token_count, request_hash; and a short job-run history export aggregation_job_runs_20270412.json (referenced, stored in internal drive link).

Recommended next steps:
1) Offer Novum a provisional credit for the duplicate 24,280 tokens while we complete a full dedupe and apply permanent correction (credit or invoice adjustment).
2) Provide Novum the per-request export and a short reconciliation table showing invoice snapshot vs. post-processing settled total.
3) Operational fix: add stricter idempotency on retry ingestion for websocket replay to avoid replays without request_id. Jonas: can you confirm ETA for that fix?

ETA: I can deliver the per-request CSV and reconciliation table in the next 90 minutes. If you want us to hold collections until the ticket resolves, advise and we'll pause attempts for this tenant.

Monica Patel
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

--- Message 4 (newest) ---
From: Lena Park <lena.park@novum.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discrepancy: Collection Posted, Token total mismatch (TXID attached)

Thanks for the fast turnaround and clear summary. Novum is happy to accept a provisional credit for the 24,280 tokens while you complete the dedupe and provide the final adjustment.

Can you:
- Send the per-request export (we need it for our treasury team),
- Share the reconciliation table (invoice snapshot vs settled total), and
- Put a short note on the account that a provisional credit was issued (we'll need a credit memo for our ledger).

Also, please provide an estimated date for the operational fix and whether any retrospective credits older than Apr 12 might be impacted (we'll want to know scope).

If you can send the CSV and the reconciliation table to finance@novumpayments.com, we'll confirm receipt and clear the hold on our end.

Appreciate the rapid help — Lena

Lena Park
Head of Finance — Novum AI
lena.park@novum.ai

--- End of thread ---
